categories.main_business_segments: Yuanjen Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial chemical manufacturing and trading, wholesale of gasoline and diesel, and building leasing. Its main product categories include chemicals (44%), plastics (35%), and oil products (20%). The company also plans to develop new products such as lubricants, specialty chemicals, and plastic pellets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company functions mainly as a logistics and trading firm without an in-house R&D department or manufacturing processes. It relies on sourcing from major upstream petrochemical producers and focuses on logistics, storage, and distribution. It plans to enhance product development and market promotion through cross-departmental integration to adapt to future diversification trends.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yuanjen serves a broad customer base in Taiwan and China, with Taiwan accounting for 63% of sales, China 25%, and other regions 12%. Its customers span various industries including electronic manufacturers and chemical product users. The company maintains diversified downstream clients and emphasizes stable supply relationships with major petrochemical suppliers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with sales and operational bases in northern, central, and southern Taiwan, as well as in Shanghai and Guangzhou in China. It has also established subsidiaries in Vietnam and plans to expand into Thailand and other Southeast Asian markets to diversify and grow its presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuanjen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the petrochemical supply chain, acting as a logistics and distribution channel for petrochemical raw materials and products. It sources raw materials from upstream refiners and petrochemical producers and supplies to downstream manufacturers and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company currently lacks a formal R&D department but plans to strengthen new product and customer development to support business diversification. It emphasizes market research, promotion, and integration across departments to capture emerging opportunities. Sustainability and environmental compliance are also strategic priorities, with ongoing efforts in ESG and climate risk management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale and distribution of industrial chemicals, plastics, and oil products. The company also earns income from leasing properties and financial investments. It benefits from both domestic sales and export activities, with a focus on volume growth and cost control to improve profitability.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanjen is a well-established and recognized player in Taiwan's chemical raw material logistics sector. While it holds a modest market share domestically (approximately 1.14% in chemical raw material wholesale), it competes in a highly fragmented and competitive market influenced by global petrochemical producers and regional supply dynamics. The company leverages its extensive logistics network and longstanding supplier relationships to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$8.39 billion in 2024, reflecting an 11.89% growth over the previous year. Net profit increased by 73.27% to NT$347 million, supported by improved operational performance and substantial non-operating income. Total assets reached NT$8.23 billion, with equity attributable to owners at NT$5.56 billion, indicating a stable financial position and positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanjen emphasizes its long-standing industry experience of over 40 years, extensive logistics and storage capabilities across Taiwan and China, and diversified product portfolio. Its strengths include strong supplier relationships, broad market coverage, and the ability to quickly respond to market changes. The company also focuses on sustainability initiatives and compliance to meet evolving customer and regulatory demands.
